I suggest Low-to-High Cable Fly in place of the pushdown. The elbow stays almost fixed during a fly, so it puts far less stress on the joint. Tap Swap on the card to make the change.

Dips and overhead extensions load the elbow even more than pushdowns, so I'd skip both today.

⚠️ Keep the pressing movements light enough to stay pain-free. If the elbow gets sharp pain or the pain lingers, stop and get it checked by a professional.

Where do you feel it: on the bench press, or only when you extend your arm?
